content.short: With Foreon, you can bet on future events, while also getting unbiased real-time forecasts on events that matter most to you.
content.description: Foreon Network will do things differently as we are building an information market platform where users can trade on the predicted outcome of future events, creating a share portfolio based on their forecasts to earn a return which offers an alternative to betting platforms with high fees, restrictions, and poor accessibility. Foreon Network is decentralized, meaning that predictions are controlled by smart contracts operating on a distributed network of computers that is not controlled by any single entity and outcomes resolved by decentralized Oracles.
